entries.title: Transparent Gear Clock Tower
entries.description: A tall, mostly transparent clock tower with stacked gear trains, a swinging pendulum, and labeled hour/minute/second hands where gears rotate, mesh, and transfer motion while the clock face updates time and trails trace gear tooth paths.
entries.seed: Transparent Gear Clock Tower: A tall, mostly transparent clock tower with stacked gear trains, a swinging pendulum, and labeled hour/minute/second hands where gears rotate, mesh, and transfer motion while the clock face updates time and trails trace gear tooth paths.

entries.title: Exploded View Gearbox Clock
entries.description: A mechanical clock frozen in mid‑air “exploded view” where gears start detached and slowly slide, rotate, and snap into place, each part glowing briefly on contact, until the assembled clock runs and drives the hands.
entries.seed: Exploded View Gearbox Clock: A mechanical clock frozen in mid‑air “exploded view” where gears start detached and slowly slide, rotate, and snap into place, each part glowing briefly on contact, until the assembled clock runs and drives the hands.

entries.title: Planetary Gear Solar Clock
entries.description: A central sun gear drives orbiting planet gears that carry small clock faces, where the planets orbit, spin, and periodically align, and colored arrows and labels show how rotation ratios produce different time speeds on each mini‑clock.
entries.seed: Planetary Gear Solar Clock: A central sun gear drives orbiting planet gears that carry small clock faces, where the planets orbit, spin, and periodically align, and colored arrows and labels show how rotation ratios produce different time speeds on each mini‑clock.

entries.title: Pendulum-Regulated Gear Train
entries.description: A long pendulum swings with a fading motion trail, engaging an escapement wheel that ticks gear-by-gear, with each tick advancing a visible gear train and incrementing a digital time label floating above the assembly.
entries.seed: Pendulum-Regulated Gear Train: A long pendulum swings with a fading motion trail, engaging an escapement wheel that ticks gear-by-gear, with each tick advancing a visible gear train and incrementing a digital time label floating above the assembly.

entries.title: Gear-Driven Orrery Clock
entries.description: A gear network at the base rotates miniature planets on arms around a central “sun clock,” where planetary orbits and spins are gear-coupled to the clock’s second and minute hands, with semi-transparent orbit rings and labels.
entries.seed: Gear-Driven Orrery Clock: A gear network at the base rotates miniature planets on arms around a central “sun clock,” where planetary orbits and spins are gear-coupled to the clock’s second and minute hands, with semi-transparent orbit rings and labels.

entries.title: Clockwork City with Gear Streets
entries.description: A small city whose streets are long gears and racks that slide and rotate, driving clock towers and rooftop clocks that turn as vehicles roll along, with collisions transferring rotation and colored arrows indicating torque flow.
entries.seed: Clockwork City with Gear Streets: A small city whose streets are long gears and racks that slide and rotate, driving clock towers and rooftop clocks that turn as vehicles roll along, with collisions transferring rotation and colored arrows indicating torque flow.

entries.title: Mechanical Calendar Clock
entries.description: Interlocking date, day, and month wheels with teeth engage a central time gear, where every simulated “midnight” causes the date disc to click forward, and once per rotation the month ring advances with a highlighted sector.
entries.seed: Mechanical Calendar Clock: Interlocking date, day, and month wheels with teeth engage a central time gear, where every simulated “midnight” causes the date disc to click forward, and once per rotation the month ring advances with a highlighted sector.

entries.title: Gear Transmission Stress Visualizer
entries.description: A set of meshing gears rotates under a clear casing, their teeth color-shifting from cool blue to warm red depending on torque, while a connected clock face speeds up or slows down with load changes controlled by a draggable weight.

entries.title: Floating Gear Constellation Clock
entries.description: In a light sky backdrop, floating gears of different sizes rotate and drift, occasionally colliding and snapping into temporary gear trains that briefly power glowing clock faces before detaching and drifting apart again.
entries.seed: Floating Gear Constellation Clock: In a light sky backdrop, floating gears of different sizes rotate and drift, occasionally colliding and snapping into temporary gear trains that briefly power glowing clock faces before detaching and drifting apart again.

entries.title: Water-Driven Gear Clock
entries.description: A transparent waterwheel gets hit by particle-based water droplets spilling from a raised trough, turning a vertical gear train that powers a rustic clock face; leaks, flow rate, and spillover visibly speed or slow the time display.

entries.title: Magnetic Levitation Gear Clock
entries.description: Gears hover above a base plate using invisible magnetic forces shown by faint field lines; when aligned, levitating gears attach and start rotating, driving a suspended clock ring whose glowing numerals orbit and gently wobble.

entries.title: Self-Assembling Clock from Loose Gears
entries.description: Loose gears float randomly in a clear box, slowly rotating; when compatible teeth meet, they magnetically attach, forming growing gear chains that eventually assemble into a functioning clock that starts ticking once the last gear clicks in.

entries.title: Binary Gear Time Counter
